multiplechoiceresponse.p: Users in one department need a mapped drive. The maintainable way to deliver it is:

choice.div: Assign a Group Policy object to the department's OU.
Map the drive by hand on each computer.
Give every user Domain Admin rights.

div.p: Group Policy applied at the OU scales, is auditable, and is removed cleanly when the user moves. Manual mapping does not scale; Domain Admin violates least privilege.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Kerberos authentication starts failing across the domain. The most likely cause is:

choice.div: Clocks have drifted more than five minutes.

div.p: Kerberos is time-sensitive; more than five minutes of skew invalidates tickets. Keep domain controllers synchronised to reliable time sources.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: AD DS depends most critically on which service?

div.p: AD locates domain services through DNS service records. If DNS is wrong, logon and replication fail.
